lines.differs: Requires End Client payment before paying Vendor; adds specific GST/PAN tax invoice requirements.
Conditionality on End Client payment; monthly invoicing instead of milestone-based payments.
Payment conditional on End Client receipt; monthly invoicing instead of milestone-based payments.
Adds specific mention of End Client information and requires written agreements for Vendor personnel.
Broader definition including End Client info; removes specific health data/DPDP Act compliance language.
Unilateral obligations for Vendor rather than mutual; explicitly includes End Client information.
Vendor retains ownership of annotation outputs; grants AtliQ a licence rather than ownership of deliverables.
Vendor retains all rights to annotation outputs and guidelines instead of client ownership.
Vendor retains ownership of all annotation outputs and specific guidelines.
Unilateral Vendor indemnity; covers any claim by the End Client and negligence of AtliQ.
Unilateral Vendor indemnity; explicitly includes all End Client claims and Vendor personnel acts.
Unilateral Vendor indemnity; broader coverage including all Vendor acts, omissions, and End Client claims.
Vendor's liability is entirely uncapped for any losses, while AtliQ's liability remains capped.
Vendor's liability is unlimited for all losses; AtliQ's liability is capped at fees paid.
Removes Vendor's liability cap entirely while capping AtliQ's liability at fees paid.
Increases liquidated damages to 2% daily; defines time as of the essence.
Increases rate to 2% daily from 0.5% weekly; removes 5% cap and client-delay exclusions.
Increases rate to 2% of total fees daily; removes milestone-specific calculation and excludes acceptance period.
Moves dispute resolution from arbitration to Pune courts; reduces escalation period to 15 days.
Changes governing law and seat from Singapore/SIAC to India and Pune courts; shorter escalation.
Changes governing law from DIFC to India; moves jurisdiction from Dubai to Pune.
